method: Chronological walk-forward features; frozen train / calibration / test partitions by UTC date. No random split.
limitations: Historical starter confirmations require evidence available before kickoff. Postgame boxscores cannot reconstruct them.
Result/goalie statistics use all situations, include overtime and shootout game outcomes, and are not 5v5 xG, high-danger chances or GSAA.
No archived executable odds: ROI, CLV, expected value calibration and betting profitability are not evaluated.
This is a regular-season pregame two-way moneyline model; no live, puck-line, totals, playoff or preseason estimates.
